tess: quick sync  how should we encode version cohabitation in rollout metadata so SDKs act consistently?

omar: keep it tiny: soft_deprecate_ts, hard_deprecate_ts, coexist_mode (graceful|immediate), drain_pct, tenant_exceptions[], priority.

li: client bits: add client_hint_ttl (secs) default 86400. when now >= soft_deprecate_ts do one fallback probe, then exponential backoff (start 1s, cap 30s). emit metrics: last_seen_version, fallback_attempts.

tess: docs note: prefer ISO examples; API accepts unix secs. precedence: tenant_exceptions > explicit_pin > priority weight. keep v1 flat; opt-in coexist_policy later for percent rollouts.

ops-bot: canary rollout for redwood-beta-2.0 started in us-east-2 :rocket:
